notes: REF-BM-03: backend accepts user-supplied title/description on create, but the Add-bookmark UI (app.tsx AddBookmark) only exposes a URL field, so pre-save editing is not reachable, only post-save edit via the modal. REF-BM-14: tag search is implemented with a `tag:name`/`-tag:name` prefix (services/search.ts renderTerm) rather than the specified `#tag` syntax; no `#` handling exists anywhere in the code. REF-BM-23: notes are stored/edited as rich-text HTML via document.execCommand (NotesEditor.tsx), not markdown, and are not rendered/visible anywhere outside the edit modal. REF-BM-24: snapshot capture (services/snapshot.ts) uses Readability to store only the extracted article content as HTML, not a full single-file snapshot of the original page (PDF passthrough rule is correctly implemented). REF-BM-30: Netscape import (services/importer.ts parseNetscapeBookmarks) preserves title and tags but ignores ADD_DATE, so imported bookmarks get the current import time instead of the original date added. REF-BM-32: settings only cover default sort, text size, and archive opt-in (routes/preferences.ts) — there is no 'displayed items'/page-size preference anywhere in the code.
